### 🌟 Contributor Profile Card Submission

Thank you for contributing to our Open Source Community Wall! Please make sure your PR follows these checklist items before submitting.

#### 📋 Checklist
- [ ] My file is placed inside `/cards/` directory.
- [ ] My file is named `<my-github-username>.json` (e.g. `cards/octocat.json`).
- [ ] The `github` field inside my JSON file exactly matches my GitHub username.
- [ ] All required fields (`name`, `github`, `bio`, `skills`) are filled in.
- [ ] I only modified/added my own card file in `cards/` (no other files changed).
- [ ] I tested validation locally with `npm run validate` (or verified JSON format).
